name: – Loucas Fourlas, Ruggero Razza – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on an EU health workforce crisis plan: sustainability of healthcare systems and employment and working conditions in the healthcare sector
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for action, not passing a law. It wants the European Commission to draw up a long-term plan to add at least one million health workers across the EU by 2034, to fill a shortage of about 1.2 million doctors, nurses and midwives. It also calls for better pay and working conditions, mental health support, safer staffing levels, easier recognition of qualifications across countries, and more money for health in the next EU budget.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is only recommending; EU laws and national decisions come later.
- **Who it affects:** Health workers, patients, and national governments across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Member States are asked to act on these ideas.
